data.title: bn-ykr: Clarify RIBBIT RECOIL gameplay foreground hierarchy
data.description: Review the backdrop value compression, safe-platform/hazard collision grammar, batched draw-call implementation, and framebuffer/draw-order regression. just check is green; visual captures were reviewed in color and grayscale.

data.body: Blocking: the draw-budget regression samples only camera x=0, which is not one of the dense compositions. Independent RPC sampling of clean staged environment frames every 8 px found per-frame trace overflow at x=192 (4096 retained, 412 dropped), x=312 (455 dropped), x=320 (460), x=440 (256), x=448 (225), and x=456 (218). The parent e6d7815 already overflowed at those six samples, but this patch increases drops by +58, +54, +49, +102, +97, and +96 respectively, so the claimed batched headroom is not restored and the new test gives false confidence. Extend the regression across representative/worst-case camera positions and batch/cull enough work that trace.dropped is zero (or establish an explicit approved budget contract if zero is not the requirement).

data.reason: Draw-call budget regression is incomplete and fails at six dense camera positions; see thread on ribbit_recoil.rs:225. Visual hierarchy is materially improved, but merge should wait for representative zero-drop evidence or an explicit revised budget contract.

data.body: Fixed in 79ab2f2. Repeated environment helpers now cull only fully offscreen primitives and per-cell detail while preserving every visible pixel. The seven staged review PNGs are byte-identical before/after this culling fix. Added environment_draw_trace_stays_complete_across_the_entire_level, sampling camera x=0..768 every 8px; zero drops at all 97 positions. The six reported hotspots now all report dropped=0 (previous maxima 460). Full just check, including web smoke, passes.

data.reason: Verified fixed in 79ab2f2: the new 97-position regression passes and all six reported hotspots now have dropped=0.

data.body: Blocking follow-up: these new horizontal culls use nominal camera_x bounds, but draw_world renders with camera(camera_x-sx, ...) and shake reaches +/-2 px. Under a deterministic dev_explode impact, nominal x=312, 320, and 456 produce actual camera x=314, 322, and 458; compared with bf47806, the fix drops 7, 10, and 7 visible facade/detail pixels respectively at screen x=190-191. The seven no-shake review PNGs remain byte-identical, so they do not cover this edge. Cull against the shaken viewport or conservatively pad every new horizontal cull by the maximum shake offset, then add a shake-edge framebuffer regression. Preserve the now-good zero-drop result.

data.reason: Budget blocker is fixed, but 79ab2f2 introduces visible 1-2 px edge omissions during screen shake because culls use nominal rather than shaken camera bounds; see new thread on carts/ribbit-recoil.cart:1399.

data.body: Fixed in 2e22976. Every new environment cull and the backdrop mute now includes the exact +/-2px shake envelope. Added environment_culls_cover_the_maximum_screen_shake_envelope: synthetic facades wholly outside the nominal viewport must render into the extreme left/right shaken columns, so the prior omission fails directly. The 97-position zero-drop sweep still passes; all seven normal review frames remain byte-identical; 24/24 RIBBIT RECOIL tests and full just check/web smoke pass.

data.reason: Verified fixed in 2e22976: x=312/320/456 match the uncullled bf47806 reference after applying only the intentional backdrop shake-envelope extension; old nominal culls render 0 extreme-edge pixels while padded culls render 101 right-edge and 202 left-edge pixels; exhaustive zero-drop regression remains green.

Approved after 2e22976: shaken x=312/320/456 match the uncullled reference with intended backdrop padding; the new edge regression fails old nominal culls (0/0 pixels) and passes padded culls (101/202 pixels); all 97 budget samples and former hotspots retain zero drops.
